department_not_found: The requested department was not found in this tenant. Refresh the department list and choose an existing department.
department_name_exists: A department with this name already exists under the same parent. Choose a different name or parent.
department_hierarchy_cycle: The department move would create a hierarchy cycle. Choose a parent outside the department subtree.
department_has_children: The department cannot be deleted while it has child departments. Move or delete the child departments first.
department_in_use: The department cannot be deleted while a member or role data scope references it. Remove those references first.
department_version_conflict: The department was changed by another request. Reload it and try again.
invalid_department: The department data is invalid. Check its name, parent, status, order, and version.
organization_unavailable: The organization service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
group_not_found: The requested group was not found in this tenant. Refresh the group list and choose an existing group.
group_name_exists: A group with this name already exists in the tenant. Choose a different group name.
group_version_conflict: The group was changed by another request. Reload it and try again.
group_has_members: The group cannot be deleted while it has members. Remove the members first.
group_role_bound: The group cannot be deleted while a role is bound to it. Remove the role bindings first.
group_relationship_bound: The group cannot be deleted while an entity relationship references it. Remove the relationship grants first.
group_member_inactive: The principal is not an active tenant member. Activate the membership before adding the principal to this group.
dynamic_group_members_computed: Dynamic group membership is computed from the membership rule and cannot be changed manually. Update the rule or the member attributes instead.
group_rule_requires_dynamic_type: A membership rule can only be configured for a dynamic group. Choose the dynamic group type or remove the rule.
invalid_group_membership_rule: The dynamic membership rule is invalid. Use version 1, choose all or any matching, and provide 1 to 16 supported attribute conditions.
last_tenant_administrator: The last active tenant administrator cannot be removed or disabled. Assign another active administrator first.
invalid_group: The group data is invalid. Check its name, type, membership rule, description, status, order, and version.
position_not_found: The requested position was not found in this tenant. Refresh the position list and choose an existing position.
position_code_exists: A position with this code already exists in the tenant. Choose a different position code.
position_version_conflict: The position was changed by another request. Reload it and try again.
position_has_members: The position cannot be deleted while it has members. Remove the members first.
position_role_bound: The position cannot be deleted while a role is bound to it. Remove the role bindings first.
position_relationship_bound: The position cannot be deleted while an entity relationship references it. Remove the relationship grants first.
position_member_inactive: The principal is not an active tenant member. Activate the membership before assigning this position.
invalid_position: The position data is invalid. Check its code, name, status, order, and version.
tenant_not_found: The requested tenant was not found. Verify the tenant identifier and try again.
tenant_slug_exists: A tenant with this slug already exists. Choose a different tenant slug.
tenant_version_conflict: The tenant was changed by another request. Reload it and try again.
invalid_tenant: The tenant data is invalid. Check its slug, name, status, and version.
invitation_not_found: The invitation was not found in this tenant. Refresh the invitation list and choose an existing invitation.
invalid_invitation_credential: The invitation credential is invalid, revoked, or already replaced. Use the latest invitation link or ask an administrator to resend it.
invitation_expired: The invitation has expired. Ask a tenant administrator to resend it.
invitation_state_conflict: The invitation is no longer pending and cannot be changed. Refresh the invitation list before continuing.
invitation_login_name_exists: The requested login name is already in use. Choose a different login name and accept the invitation again.
invitation_binding_not_found: A default role or department no longer exists in this tenant. Ask an administrator to update or recreate the invitation.
invitation_binding_inactive: The tenant or default department is inactive. Ask an administrator to activate it or update the invitation.
invalid_invitation: The invitation data is invalid. Check the email, expiry, department, roles, login name, and password requirements.
